meanings.usage: 指用于化装舞会等场合的特殊服饰
可指演出、化装活动等的特定服装，也可指某个时期或地区的传统服饰
常见搭配：be impatient to do sth. 迫不及待做某事；be impatient with sb./sth. 对某人/事不耐烦
除了指床上用品，还可表示薄的片状物，如a sheet of paper一张纸

meanings.meaning: 有效的，有效果的（强调能够产生预期的效果，区别于efficient（高效的，侧重效率））

meanings.usage: 可形容衣物、家具等让人感觉舒服，也可形容人感觉自在

meanings.meaning: 面包师，面包店老板（由动词bake（烘焙）加表示人的后缀-er构成）

meanings.usage: 常见搭配：frighten sb. 吓到某人；frighten sb. into doing sth. 威胁某人做某事

meanings.meaning: 储藏室，库房（复合名词，由store（储藏）和room（房间）构成）
noun (uncountable). 电，电力（表示电力、电流的不可数名词，相关形容词为electric（电的））

meanings.usage: 文中指电表，也可作为长度单位“米”，美式拼写为meter
过去式和过去分词为fled，强调因害怕、危险而快速逃离
可作及物或不及物动词，强调关门等动作的力度大、声音响

meanings.meaning: -able 形容词后缀，跟在动词后表达＂能够被...的＂

phrases.usage: 表示“装扮成，打扮成”，用于化装、角色扮演等场景

examples.en: She intended to dress up as a ghost for the party.
examples.zh: 她打算在派对上装扮成鬼魂。

examples.en: Children love dressing up as cartoon characters on Halloween.
examples.zh: 孩子们喜欢在万圣节装扮成卡通人物。

phrases.usage: 表示“试穿（衣物、配饰等）”，是动副短语，宾语为代词时要放在短语中间

examples.en: She was impatient to try the new costume on.
examples.zh: 她迫不及待要试穿那件新的化装服。

examples.en: You should try the shoes on before buying them.
examples.zh: 你买鞋之前应该先试穿一下。

phrases.usage: 表示“由……组成，由……构成”，不用于被动语态和进行时态

examples.en: The costume consisted only of a sheet, but it was very effective.
examples.zh: 这件化装服只用了一张床单做成，但效果非常好。

examples.en: The research team consists of three scientists and two engineers.
examples.zh: 这个研究团队由三名科学家和两名工程师组成。

phrases.usage: 表示“查明，弄清楚”，侧重通过努力、调查等获知事实真相

examples.en: She wanted to find out whether the costume was comfortable to wear.
examples.zh: 她想弄清楚这件化装服穿起来是否舒服。

examples.en: Please find out when the train leaves.
examples.zh: 请查一下火车什么时候开。

phrases.usage: 表示“大叫一声，发出一声叫喊”，let out可表示发出（声音、光等）

examples.en: The man let out a cry and jumped back several paces when he saw the 'ghost'.
examples.zh: 那个男人看到“鬼魂”的时候大叫一声，往后跳了好几步。

examples.en: She let out a cry of surprise when she saw the birthday gift.
examples.zh: 她看到生日礼物的时候发出了一声惊喜的叫喊。

grammar.title: 过去完成时
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某个动作或时间之前已经完成的动作，强调“过去的过去” 常与after, before, by the time等引导的时间状语连用，说明两个过去动作的先后顺序

examples.en: After her husband had gone to work, Mrs. Richards sent her children to school.
examples.zh: 丈夫上班之后，理查兹太太把孩子们送去了学校。

examples.en: She had made her costume the night before, so she was eager to try it on.
examples.zh: 她前一天晚上就做好了化装服，所以迫不及待想要试穿。

grammar.title: too...to... 结构
grammar.structure: too + 形容词/副词 + to do sth.
grammar.definition: 表示“太……以至于不能……”，是一种表达否定含义的结构 当主语是不定式的逻辑宾语时，不定式用主动形式表被动含义

examples.en: She was too excited to do any housework that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上她太兴奋了，什么家务都做不进去。

examples.en: The box is too heavy for the little boy to carry.
examples.zh: 这个箱子太重了，小男孩搬不动。

grammar.title: 现在分词作原因状语
grammar.definition: 现在分词短语可以在句中作状语，说明主句动作发生的原因，相当于原因状语从句 现在分词的逻辑主语要和主句主语保持一致，表否定时not放在现在分词前面

examples.en: Not wanting to frighten the poor man, Mrs. Richards quickly hid under the stairs.
examples.zh: 因为不想吓到这个可怜的人，理查兹太太迅速躲到了楼梯底下。

examples.en: Feeling tired, he stopped working to have a rest.
examples.zh: 因为感觉很累，他停下工作休息了一会儿。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + be too + 形容词 + to do sth.

original.en: She was too excited to do any housework that morning.
original.zh: 那天早上她太兴奋了，什么家务都做不进去。

imitations.en: He was too nervous to say a word in front of the audience.
imitations.zh: 他太紧张了，在观众面前一句话都说不出来。

imitations.en: The coffee is too hot to drink right now.
imitations.zh: 咖啡太烫了，现在没法喝。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + intend to do sth.

original.en: She intended to dress up as a ghost for the fancy-dress party.
original.zh: 她打算在化装舞会上装扮成鬼魂。

imitations.en: I intend to travel to Japan with my family this summer holiday.
imitations.zh: 我打算今年暑假和家人一起去日本旅行。

imitations.en: The company intends to set up a new branch in Guangzhou next year.
imitations.zh: 这家公司打算明年在广州开一家新的分公司。

patterns.pattern: Just as + 从句, 主句

original.en: Just as Mrs. Richards was entering the dining-room, there was a knock on the front door.
original.zh: 就在理查兹太太走进餐厅的时候，前门传来了敲门声。

imitations.en: Just as I was leaving the house, it started to rain heavily.
imitations.zh: 就在我出门的时候，开始下大雨了。

imitations.en: Just as he finished his speech, the audience broke into warm applause.
imitations.zh: 就在他结束演讲的时候，观众爆发出了热烈的掌声。

lines.en: After her husband had gone to work.
lines.zh: 理查兹夫人等丈夫上班走后，把孩子送去上学，然后来到楼上自己的卧室。

lines.en: Mrs.. Richards sent her children to school and went upstairs to her bedroom.
lines.zh: 那天上午，她兴奋得什么家务活都不想做，因为晚上她要同丈夫一起参加一个化装舞会。

lines.en: She was too excited to do any housework that morning, for in the evening she would be going to a fancy-dress party with her husband.
lines.zh: 她打算装扮成鬼的模样。

lines.en: She intended to dress up as a ghost and as she had made her costume the night before, she was impatient to try it on.
lines.zh: 头天晚上她已把化装服做好，这时她急于想试试。

lines.en: Though the costume consisted only of a sheet, it was very effective.
lines.zh: 尽管化装服仅由一个被单制成，却十分逼真。

lines.en: After putting it on, Mrs.. Richards went downstairs.
lines.zh: 理查兹夫人穿上化装服后下了楼，想看穿起来是否舒服。

lines.en: She wanted to find out whether it would be comfortable to wear.
lines.zh: 理查兹夫人刚刚走进餐厅，前门就传来敲门声。

lines.en: Just as Mrs.. Richards was entering the dinning room, there was a knock on the front door.
lines.zh: 她知道来了一定面包师。

lines.en: She knew that it must be the baker .
lines.zh: 她曾告诉过面包师，如果她不去开门，他可直接进门，把面包放在厨房的桌上。

lines.en: She had told him to come straight in if ever she failed to open the door and to leave the bread on the kitchen table.
lines.zh: 理查兹夫人不想吓唬这个可怜人，便赶紧躲到了楼梯下的小储藏室里。

lines.en: Not wanting to frighten the poor man, Mrs.. Richards quickly hid in the small storeroom under the stairs.
lines.zh: 她听见前门被打开，走廊里响起重重的脚步声。

lines.en: She heard the front door open and heavy footsteps in the hall.
lines.zh: 突然贮藏门开了，一个男人走了进来。

lines.en: Suddenly the door of the storeroom was opened and a man entered.
lines.zh: 理查兹夫人这才想到一定是供电局来人查电表了。

lines.en: Mrs.. Richards realized that it must be the man from the Electricity Board who had come to read the meter.
She tried to explain the situation, saying 'It's only me', but it was too late.
lines.zh: ”然后想进行一番解释，但已来不及了。

lines.en: The man let out cry and jumped back several paces.
lines.zh: 那人大叫了一声，惊退了几步。

lines.en: When Mrs.. Richards walked towards him, he fled, slamming the door behind him.
lines.zh: 理查兹夫人朝他走去，只见他“砰”的一声关上门逃走了。

questions.q: What did the man expect to find under the stairs?
questions.zh: 那个人以为楼梯下面会有什么？
questions.a: Nothing unusual — he certainly did not expect to find a “ghost”. He had come to read the electricity meter, which was in the storeroom under the stairs.
questions.aZh: 他以为下面没什么异常——更没想到会遇到“鬼”。他是供电局来查电表的，电表就装在楼梯下的储藏室里。
questions.hint: 出自 “it must be the man from the Electricity Board who had come to read the meter” 与结尾他惊叫逃走的情节。

questions.q: What did Mrs. Richards intend to dress up as, and what was her costume made of?
questions.zh: 理查兹夫人打算装扮成什么？她的化装服是用什么做的？
questions.a: She intended to dress up as a ghost, and her costume consisted only of a sheet.
questions.aZh: 她打算装扮成鬼，而她的化装服仅由一条床单制成。
questions.hint: 见 “She intended to dress up as a ghost” 与 “the costume consisted only of a sheet”。

questions.q: Why did Mrs. Richards go downstairs after putting on the costume?
questions.zh: 穿上化装服后，理查兹夫人为什么下楼？
questions.a: She wanted to find out whether the costume would be comfortable to wear.
questions.aZh: 她想看看这套化装服穿起来是否舒服。
questions.hint: 见 “She wanted to find out whether it would be comfortable to wear”。

questions.q: Why did Mrs. Richards hide in the small storeroom under the stairs?
questions.zh: 理查兹夫人为什么躲进楼梯下的小储藏室？
questions.a: She heard a knock, thought it must be the baker, and did not want to frighten the poor man, so she hid quickly.
questions.aZh: 她听到敲门声，以为是面包师来了，不想吓着这个可怜人，于是赶紧躲了起来。
questions.hint: 见 “She knew that it must be the baker” 与 “Not wanting to frighten the poor man”。

questions.q: Why did the man let out a cry and flee when he saw Mrs. Richards?
questions.zh: 那人一见理查兹夫人为什么就惊叫一声、夺门而逃？
questions.a: Because she was dressed as a ghost with a sheet over her, he thought he had met a real ghost. She said “It's only me”, but it was too late to explain.
questions.aZh: 因为她裹着床单扮成鬼，他以为撞见了真鬼。她喊了声“是我”，可解释已经来不及了。
questions.hint: 见结尾 “let out a cry and jumped back several paces ... he fled, slamming the door behind him”。

translation:
理查兹夫人等丈夫上班走后，把孩子送去上学，然后来到楼上自己的卧室。
那天上午，她兴奋得什么家务活都不想做，因为晚上她要同丈夫一起参加一个化装舞会。
她打算装扮成鬼的模样。
头天晚上她已把化装服做好，这时她急于想试试。
尽管化装服仅由一个被单制成，却十分逼真。
理查兹夫人穿上化装服后下了楼，想看穿起来是否舒服。
理查兹夫人刚刚走进餐厅，前门就传来敲门声。
她知道来了一定面包师。
她曾告诉过面包师，如果她不去开门，他可直接进门，把面包放在厨房的桌上。
理查兹夫人不想吓唬这个可怜人，便赶紧躲到了楼梯下的小储藏室里。
她听见前门被打开，走廊里响起重重的脚步声。
突然贮藏门开了，一个男人走了进来。
理查兹夫人这才想到一定是供电局来人查电表了。
她说了声“是我，别怕！
”然后想进行一番解释，但已来不及了。
那人大叫了一声，惊退了几步。
理查兹夫人朝他走去，只见他“砰”的一声关上门逃走了。
title: It's Only Me
subtitle: 是我呀

lead.question: 理查兹夫人本想吓唬面包师，为什么反而把查电表的人吓跑了？
lead.warmup: 试想一下：你裹着一条白床单扮成鬼，刚走到楼下，门外忽然响起敲门声。理查兹夫人就碰上这样的场面——她以为来的是送面包的人，怕吓着他便躲进储藏室，谁知推门进来的却是查电表的人，结果反被吓得夺门而逃。本课用一连串过去完成时和分词短语，把这场阴差阳错的误会讲得既紧张又有趣。
goals: 掌握 costume、consist、sheet、effective、frighten、ghost、storey 等本课核心词汇。
熟练运用过去完成时与过去将来进行时，叙述过去先后发生的动作。
理解现在分词短语作状语（含否定式 Not wanting...）的用法。
能用 dress up as、try on、just as、too...to 等结构复述故事。
lead.summary: 本课讲理查兹夫人为晚上的化装舞会做好一件“床单鬼”服装。她刚下楼试穿，前门就传来敲门声。她以为是面包师，便躲进楼梯下的小储藏室，免得吓着对方。不料来人是供电局查电表的人，一开门迎面撞见“鬼”，惊叫一声夺路而逃。故事用过去完成时和现在分词状语，把这场误会讲得紧凑好笑。
lead.tips: 注意 try on 的宾语若是代词须放中间，说 try it on，不能说 try on it；同理 dress up as 后接身份名词，如 as a ghost。

exercises.q: 汉译英：尽管化装服仅由一条床单制成，却十分逼真。
exercises.a: Though the costume consisted only of a sheet, it was very effective.
exercises.note: consist of 用主动语态，不用被动

exercises.q: 填入正确介词：She intended to dress up ___ a ghost.
exercises.note: dress up as 表示“装扮成……”

exercises.q: 句型转换：把 She was too excited to do any housework that morning. 改成 so...that 结构。
exercises.a: She was so excited that she could not do any housework that morning.
exercises.note: too...to 与 so...that 的转换

exercises.q: 改错：Wanting not to frighten the poor man, Mrs. Richards quickly hid in the storeroom.
exercises.a: Not wanting to frighten the poor man, Mrs. Richards quickly hid in the storeroom.
exercises.note: 分词否定式要把 not 提前

exercises.q: 选词填空（effective / frighten）：Though it looked simple, the costume was very ___, and it nearly ___ the man.
exercises.note: effective 逼真有效；frighten 使害怕

exercises.q: 改错：They live in a two-storeys house near the corner.
exercises.a: They live in a two-storey house near the corner.
exercises.note: 复合形容词中 storey 用单数

exercises.q: 汉译英：她曾告诉面包师，如果她不去开门，他可直接进来，把面包放在厨房桌上。
exercises.a: She had told him to come straight in if ever she failed to open the door and to leave the bread on the kitchen table.
exercises.note: 过去完成时 + if ever 表强调

quiz.q: 理查兹夫人的化装服仅由什么做成？
quiz.note: a sheet 意为“一条床单”

quiz.q: 在 “it must be the man from the Electricity Board who had come to read the meter” 中，who 引导的是？
quiz.note: who 修饰 the man，作定语从句主语

quiz.q: “It's only me” 这句话是谁说的？
options: The man from the Electricity Board
quiz.note: 这是理查兹夫人喊的话

quiz.q: 推开储藏室门的那个男人其实是？
options: the man from the Electricity Board
quiz.note: 他是供电局来查电表的人

quiz.q: 理查兹夫人为什么躲进储藏室？
quiz.note: 她以为来的是面包师，怕吓着他

quiz.q: 课文中表示“那天晚上她将和丈夫去参加化装舞会”用的是哪种形式？
quiz.note: 过去将来进行时 would be going
